text:
mike: flagging a weird dashboard read on /v1/chat/completions this morning. p50 steady ~60ms, p95 jumped to ~520ms for the canary slice but p99 was flat. sample count looks normal. anyone digging in? :thinking:
anya: can you paste the console numbers + whether the dashboard was showing merged origins or a single origin? we've had confusion there before.
mike: console: endpoint=/v1/chat/completions rollout=canary merged p50=62ms p95=520ms p99=980ms samples=2.1k
dave: quick thought: if a minority of requests hit a slow path (fallback model or cold kvcache miss) that'll move p95 without moving p99 much. are we tagging origin in telemetry?
ravi: checked logs: there were ~30 fallback events between 08:23-08:28 adding ~180-220ms each. also a brief kvcache evict at 08:22. ops-bot: "fallback annotated at 2026-03-24T08:24:11Z on node g4-07"
anya: looks provenance-related. our product folks sometimes interpret the console percentiles as backend-only which causes escalation. we should make the provenance explicit in the UI.
ui-sam: UX suggestion: add a small "provenance chip" next to the percentiles that reads either "provenance: merged" or "provenance: backend-only". chip is clickable to expand inline table with per-origin p50/p95/p99 and counts. default remains merged to reflect end-to-end latency, but make the chip prominent.
dave: +1. also add a hover tooltip clarifying "Merged = combined ingress + kvcache + backend. Backend-only excludes ingress and KV cache."
ravi: telemetry action: runtime will ensure every latency event includes origin in the envelope (ingress, kvcache_hit, kvcache_miss, backend, fallback). if origin is missing mark as unknown and surface a warning in the UI. ETA 48h for forward events, backfill best-effort for 7 days.
anya: alert idea: advisory alert that triggers to canary when merged_p95 - backend_p95 > 75ms and merged_samples > 200. It should post to #canary-alerts with a quick breakdown per origin. keeps noise low but surfaces cache/fallback tails.
ui-sam: I'll prototype the chip + expand table in FigJam and send a screenshot. table columns: Origin | p50 | p95 | p99 | samples. small link to docs: "how percentiles are computed".
dave: example query we can use for checks: ```sql
SELECT origin,
  percentile(50, latency_ms) AS p50,
  percentile(95, latency_ms) AS p95,
  percentile(99, latency_ms) AS p99,
  count(*) AS samples
FROM latency_events
WHERE endpoint='/v1/chat/completions' AND rollout='canary' AND time >= '2026-03-24T07:30:00Z' AND time <= '2026-03-24T09:00:00Z'
GROUP BY origin;
```
mike: owners: ui-sam for chip mock + figma, ravi for telemetry changes, dave for alert rule + query, anya will update docs and add a short note in the console explaining default semantics. i'll follow up in 48h. thanks all. :thumbsup:"
